title: 弹性潜在循环：一种模型适配所有循环次数的语言模型
summary: 提出弹性潜在循环（ELR）训练方法，使循环语言模型在单次循环时与同规模非循环模型性能相当，额外循环可换取更高精度。通过门控状态更新、混合循环次数训练和循环索引条件化实现，在4B稠密和30B-A3B MoE模型上验证，四循环分别提升7.25和4.75分。
summary_en: We present Elastic Latent Recurrence (ELR), a recipe for training looped language models without the one-loop tax. At one loop, an ELR model matches a non-recurrent model of the same size in cost and accuracy, while each additional loop buys more accuracy. Three choices enable this: a gated state update with learned step size, mixed loop counts per optimizer update, and conditioning each pass on its loop index and budget. On 4B dense and 30B-A3B MoE models, four loops add 7.25 and 4.75 points respectively, yielding Koi-4B which scores 18 at one loop and 29 at four loops on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index.
